title: script.rs parses modifier keys twice
body:
`chord` in `script.rs` has its own super, shift, ctrl and alt match, and `named_key` has the same four arms. `press` and `release` run `named_key(rest).or_else(|| chord(rest))`, though `chord` tries `named_key` first. The `Error` and `Close` arms of the message loop are identical.

## Proposal

`chord` uses `named_key` for modifiers, `press` and `release` call only `chord`, and the two arms merge with `|`.
close_reason: Done in 0eaca92. chord takes modifiers from named_key, press and release call only chord, and the Error and Close arms are one.
